question: Candy can be packaged in boxes of 1, 5, or 16 candies.  You receive an order for 238 candies.  What is the least number of boxes needed to fill this order?
Apples cost $45.99 per pound.  There are 16 ounces in a pound.  How much will 0.70 ounces of apples cost?

Callie biked 4 miles from home to school at an average speed of 10 mi/h.  He walked home at a speed of 3 mi/h.  What was her average speed on the trip to school and back home?   Express your answer as a decimal to the nearest tenth.

It takes 46 seconds to fill a 2-ounce cup with ingredient A and 33 seconds to fill it with ingredient B.  What is the absolute difference in the number of minutes it takes to fill the cup with ingredients A and B?  Express your answer as decimal to the nearest hundredth.
A theater holds 290 people.  If 261 people are in attendance, what percent of the theater is empty?
There are 2.54 cm in an inch and 5280 feet in a mile.  How many centimeters are in a mile?  Express your answer to the nearest thousand.
Four points have these coordinates: A(5,7), B(7,1), C(17,m) and D(-1,3).  If line segments AB and CD are perpendicular, what is the value of m?
A game console is marked as 15% off its original price.  Callie buys it and pays $250.75.  By how much was the original price reduced?
If Callie can mow the yard in 1.5 hours and Aidan can mow the same yard in 45 minutes, how many minutes will it take them to do the job together?

The formula to convert Celsius (C) to Fahrenheit (F) is $F = \frac{9}{5} C + 32$.  If Callie misreads the Celsius temperature by $2\degree$, by how many degrees Fahrenheit will she be off?  Express your answer as a decimal to the nearest tenth.
The positive number A is 160% of another number B.  What percent of 25A is 16B?
Callie follows a path from A to C, always moving either up or to the right.  What is the probability that her path goes through B?  Express your answer as a common fraction.

A tortoise challenged a hare to a 5-mile race.  The tortoise ran at a speed of 0.63 mi/h.  The hare ran at a speed of 36 mi/h.  The hare crossed the finish line at noon.  At what time did the tortoise cross the finish line?  Express your answer in hours and minutes to the nearest minute.

An urn contains 5 red, 6 blue, 3 white and 8 yellow tokens.  Callie selects 2 tokens, without replacement.  What is the probability she will draw 2 red tokens?  Express your answer as a common fraction.
3 people, each working at the same rate, can finish a project in 8 days.  How many days would it take 4 people working at the same rate to finish the project?
In this conversation between Anne and Diana, what is the greatest possible value of X?
A rectangular prism has dimensions: x, (x+2), and 4 units.  If the volume is 80 units, what is the value of x?
In square millimeters, whatis the area of a triangle with side lengths 115mm, 9.2cm and 0.069 meters?
